categories.main_business_segments: Chung Jye Investment Holding Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the footwear manufacturing industry, focusing on OEM production of athletic and casual shoes. The company serves major international brands and provides specialized R&D services to meet client needs. It also engages in investment holding through various subsidiaries involved in footwear production and related activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated and smart factory processes such as computer-controlled sewing, cutting, printing, and robotic spraying. It invests in innovative materials like eco-friendly and recyclable shoe components, 3D printing for customization, and smart footwear technologies integrating sensors and connectivity. Continuous R&D efforts focus on process optimization, environmental sustainability, and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chung Jye serves leading international footwear brands, including major athletic and outdoor brands, acting as a key OEM partner. Its primary markets are China and the Americas, which together account for over 70% of sales. The company also targets emerging markets and new international brands to diversify its customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities across multiple countries including China (Guangdong, Jiangxi, Henan provinces), Vietnam (Hai Duong, Ninh Binh, Tuyen Quang, Bac Kan), Taiwan, India, Indonesia, and the United States. It is expanding production capacity in India and Indonesia and maintains a global footprint to mitigate geopolitical and tariff risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chung Jye functions primarily as a midstream footwear manufacturer within the supply chain, focusing on OEM production for brand owners. It sources raw materials locally to optimize costs and reduce carbon footprint but does not engage in upstream raw material production or downstream retail operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding global production capacity, especially in Southeast Asia and India, to meet growing brand orders and diversify risk. R&D focuses on automation, process refinement, eco-friendly materials, and smart footwear technologies. Sustainability initiatives include green energy adoption and compliance with environmental regulations. The company also emphasizes talent development and lean manufacturing to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through contract manufacturing (OEM) of footwear products for international brands. The company earns income by fulfilling production orders, with no direct retail or licensing revenue streams. It also receives government subsidies and interest income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chung Jye competes with other global footwear OEM manufacturers primarily located in Asia. It positions itself as a reliable, high-quality supplier with strong R&D capabilities and diversified global production bases. Its competitive advantages include long-term partnerships with major brands, multi-country manufacturing footprint, and commitment to sustainability and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chung Jye reported revenues of approximately NT$26.99 billion, an 18.7% increase from 2023, with net profit of NT$1.82 billion, slightly down 7.4%. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume, reaching a record 40.53 million pairs sold. It maintains a solid financial structure with increasing equity and ongoing capital investments to expand capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chung Jye offers high-quality, innovative footwear manufacturing services tailored to international brand standards. Its value lies in strong R&D collaboration with clients, advanced automated production, diversified global manufacturing to mitigate risks, and commitment to sustainability through eco-friendly materials and green energy. These factors differentiate it as a trusted long-term partner in the competitive footwear OEM market.
